details:
service-roles-registry runs code during `npm install` that reads the process environment, credential files or the machine's identity and contains a request to an external collection endpoint:

- 99.0.2 (published 2026-11-02 17:53 UTC): its `preinstall` script is `node index.js`, which npm runs during `npm install`. In `index.js` (SHA-256 `ca719dd4b07aeddffaf59facde11726e981bad6d15620b47407f943ea00bb496`), lines 9-15 contain a request address on a public request-collection service, `https://eog6t9e6egptozp.m.pipedream.net` (line 15), a read of the machine's identity, `os.hostname()` (line 9), a read of the machine's identity, `os.userInfo()` (line 10) and a network request call, `https.request(` (line 15).

The code is quoted from the published archive.

cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
